explication: InvoicePlane is a self-hosted invoicing and client-management application. The principal workflow is managing clients and commercial records, creating invoices or quotes, tracking payments, and reviewing financial reports; guest-facing controllers expose selected documents and payment-related pages. The graph also preserves products, projects and tasks, settings, installation, custom fields, and invoice document generation. Relationships are shown only where excerpts or README statements support them; unsampled modules are represented by their exact tree paths, with uncertain connections omitted.
